title: Admin: handover list
interface: Extends base.html. Filter form GET status select (pending, confirmed, declined, expired, cancelled, all). Table: protocol_number, kind, asset.asset_tag (link to /admin/assets/<asset_id>), employee.display_name + email, status, created_at, confirmed_at, actions (cancel form POST /admin/handovers/<id>/cancel when pending; PDF link when protocol_path). Variables: handovers, status. Czech.

uses.base: templates/base.html: Jinja layout with blocks title and content; header nav (Moje zařízení '/', for admins: /admin/assets, /admin/handovers, /admin/employees, /admin/audit), current user e-mail and a logout form POST /auth/logout; flashed messages via get_flashed_messages(with_categories=true); links /static/style.css
